finding: The subject selects `specs/request-consistency.md#requirements` as a governing requirement, but the Reviewer Request contains no Input snapshot with that filePath. The selected requirement cannot be compared with the current consumer contracts, so the required governing input is missing.

The subject selects `specs/image-cache.md#preview-cleanup` as a governing requirement, but the What to build section does not list preview cache cleanup as a delivered behavior, and the selected section only defines a 24-hour cleanup of documentation renderer image previews unrelated to Validation Report, Result Summary, Reader Index, cache lookup, parser, access review, promotion, recovery or runtime migration. An unrelated selected section is a gap and cannot expand the delivery scope.

runtime-migration states the exact successful result of promote as {status, artifactId, trackedStateId} with no summary field, while result-summary adds a required summary field and promotion-runtime defines the successful result as {status, artifactId, trackedStateId, summary}. All three are selected for the same delivery, so the caller-visible promote success contract is contradictory and an implementer cannot satisfy all of them.

runtime-migration defines the expected filesystem failure as exactly {recovered, failureCode, priorTrackedState, baselineStatus} with no operation field, while promotion-runtime defines the same failure with an operation field {recovered, failureCode, operation, priorTrackedState, baselineStatus}. The selected requirements disagree on the caller-visible field set of the same failure result.

promotion-recovery treats the new rollback recovery result as a representation of the existing ADR 0001 rollback responsibility and concludes that no new ADR is needed. ADR 0001 states that it does not define the new recovery-result fields and failure lifecycle, so the new public recovery failure contract has no applicable ADR conclusion.

The reader index change points the link at docs/reference/validation-report.md. No Input states whether that target is a generated artifact, which would make export retention under ADR 0005 apply, or a manually maintained document, which would make it not apply. The selected conditional export retention requirement and the reader-index ADR evaluation cannot be resolved without that fact, so the applicability of external retention is unknown.

The Not required paragraph only states that the parser optimization preserves the current architecture. It does not identify which Module responsibility, Interface, Seam, dependency direction, authority or data flow is unchanged, so the exemption reasoning is generic and not sufficient.

Artifact validation under the Invalid Artifact Contract has two owners: the Parser Module owns parseArtifact validation, and the Validation Report Module owns renderReport validation, each re-implementing the same contract. Important validation behavior therefore lacks a single responsibility owner, and the spec accepts the duplicated domain policy as a cost instead of avoiding it.

The Interface reviewAccess(request) accepts only a request whose resourceId and operation are non-empty strings, but the spec requires every decision to be made for the verified principal from the existing caller boundary. No Interface input or handoff carries the verified principal, so the caller-visible contract for the identity input is undefined and cannot be tested through the public lifecycle.

Testing Decisions requires a Policy Adapter failure case to be tested through reviewAccess, but the Interfaces section defines a result only for invalid-policy, invalid-request and Artifact Reader failure. The caller-visible result for a Policy Adapter failure is undefined, so the public lifecycle test boundary cannot be verified.

promotion-recovery uses the complete Module Design format, but its Dependencies and Data Flow section has no Source/Authority table. The rule requires one table listing each declared authority source for a complete-format governing spec, and the section only describes the flow in prose, so the declared authorities cannot be checked against their owners.
